sql_calls.sql:
WITH zero_days AS (
  SELECT d.date
  FROM store.daily_sales d
  WHERE d.sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND d.date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'
  GROUP BY d.date HAVING SUM(d.units_sold)=0
), empty_days AS (
  SELECT audit_ts::date AS date FROM store.shelf_audits
  WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND status='empty' AND audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND audit_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01'
)
SELECT 'zero_sales_days' k, string_agg(date::text,',' ORDER BY date) days,
       (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.bill_id) FROM store.pos_lines p JOIN zero_days z ON p.bill_ts::date=z.date) bills,
       (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.bill_id) FROM store.pos_lines p JOIN zero_days z ON p.bill_ts::date=z.date AND p.sku_scanned IN ('ATTA-WW-1KG','ATTA-WW-10KG')) bills_other_atta,
       (SELECT SUM(f.forecast_units_per_day) FROM store.forecasts f JOIN zero_days z ON f.date=z.date WHERE f.sku='ATTA-WW-5KG') fc_units
FROM zero_days
UNION ALL
SELECT 'empty_audit_days', string_agg(date::text,',' ORDER BY date),
       (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.bill_id) FROM store.pos_lines p JOIN empty_days e ON p.bill_ts::date=e.date),
       (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.bill_id) FROM store.pos_lines p JOIN empty_days e ON p.bill_ts::date=e.date AND p.sku_scanned IN ('ATTA-WW-1KG','ATTA-WW-10KG')),
       (SELECT SUM(f.forecast_units_per_day) FROM store.forecasts f JOIN empty_days e ON f.date=e.date WHERE f.sku='ATTA-WW-5KG')
FROM empty_days;

WITH days AS (
  SELECT d.date,
         MAX(f.forecast_units_per_day) AS fc,
         MAX(d.units_sold) AS sold,
         (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.bill_id) FROM payments.pos_payments p WHERE p.ts::date = d.date) AS bills_all,
         (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.bill_id) FROM store.pos_lines l WHERE l.bill_ts::date = d.date AND l.sku_scanned='ATTA-WW-5KG') AS bills_with_atta5,
         (SELECT MAX(a.status) FROM store.shelf_audits a WHERE a.sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND a.audit_ts::date=d.date) AS audit
  FROM store.daily_sales d
  JOIN store.forecasts f ON f.date=d.date AND f.sku=d.sku
  WHERE d.sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND d.date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'
  GROUP BY d.date
)
SELECT date, fc, sold, bills_all, bills_with_atta5, audit,
       (fc-sold) AS unmet_units,
       ROUND((fc-sold)*265,2) AS unmet_inr
FROM days ORDER BY date;

WITH oos AS (
  SELECT d.date
  FROM store.daily_sales d
  WHERE d.sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND d.date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'
  GROUP BY d.date HAVING SUM(d.units_sold)=0
), bills AS (
  SELECT p.bill_id, p.ts::date AS d,
         EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM store.pos_lines l WHERE l.bill_id=p.bill_id AND l.sku_scanned='ATTA-WW-5KG') AS bought5,
         EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM store.pos_lines l WHERE l.bill_id=p.bill_id AND l.sku_scanned IN ('ATTA-WW-1KG','ATTA-WW-10KG')) AS bought_other_atta
  FROM payments.pos_payments p
  WHERE p.ts::date IN (SELECT date FROM oos)
)
SELECT 'oos_zero_sales_days' k,
       (SELECT string_agg(date::text,',' ORDER BY date) FROM oos) days,
       COUNT(DISTINCT bill_id) bills_all,
       COUNT(DISTINCT bill_id) FILTER (WHERE NOT bought5) left_without_5kg,
       COUNT(DISTINCT bill_id) FILTER (WHERE NOT bought5 AND NOT bought_other_atta) left_without_any_atta
FROM bills
UNION ALL
SELECT 'oos_audited_empty_days',
       (SELECT string_agg(audit_ts::date::text,',' ORDER BY audit_ts) FROM store.shelf_audits WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND status='empty' AND audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND audit_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01'),
       COUNT(DISTINCT p.bill_id),
       COUNT(DISTINCT p.bill_id) FILTER (WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM store.pos_lines l WHERE l.bill_id=p.bill_id AND l.sku_scanned='ATTA-WW-5KG')),
       COUNT(DISTINCT p.bill_id) FILTER (WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM store.pos_lines l WHERE l.bill_id=p.bill_id AND l.sku_scanned IN ('ATTA-WW-1KG','ATTA-WW-10KG')))
FROM payments.pos_payments p
WHERE p.ts::date IN (SELECT audit_ts::date FROM store.shelf_audits WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND status='empty' AND audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND audit_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01');
